sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the 
minor maintenance procedures P1, which must be performed every ten years as 
indicated by Y10 in the title block.

The first draft initiated by eng.
 Amr Gaber, revised by eng. Mohamed Abbas 
 Ahmad, tested by eng Mohammed El-bayaa, 
 accepted by general manager eng. Mohamed Abbas Ahmad, approved by eng. Mahmoud 
 El-Naquib head sector of Ayoun Moussa PS.

This document certified by eng. Mohamed Fayez 
Hassan EDEPC MPIS coordinator.

Safety 
Precautions

items:
A work permit must be 
 issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety 
 category

Safety fence with 
 caution marks surrounding the work area is required

Wear safety helmet, 
 shoes, breathing mask, and harness....

Transformer isolation 
 and earthing on all its sides is required

There is danger of 
 falling into the oil containment pit when working near large power 
 transformer

A proper well fixed 
 ladder should be used for climbing on tap of the transformer tank

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items: Megger (500 - 5000) volt
Multimeter
Air blower

Complete maintenance tool 
 set
Cleaning solvent

sections.text: Work to be carried out
Transformer oil system

Check the oil temperature indicates whether 
the oil or winding temperature lies in a satisfactory range in relation to their 
values in the test report, load condition and ambient temperature. Overloading 
of transformer should be made only in accordance with applicable standard.

items:
Check the oil temperature indicates whether 
the oil or winding temperature lies in a satisfactory range in relation to their 
values in the test report, load condition and ambient temperature. Overloading 
of transformer should be made only in accordance with applicable standard.

Check the flanged joints and welds for oil 
 leakage

All flanges seals and welds must be checked 
 for oil leaks

If any leakage found we must immediately 
 seal by retightening the screws replacing the seals or by welding

If the finishing coat is touched up in 
 time, the paint coat in general needs not be completely renewed

Clean the painted surface with a solvent 
 soaked rag or a steam jet blower
Paint all the service of the transformer

sections.text: OFF load tap changer
The OFF load tap changer must be operated with the transformer is de-energized

Traverse all taps for 
 cleaning the tap changer contacts

items: The OFF load tap changer must be operated with the transformer is de-energized

Traverse all taps for 
 cleaning the tap changer contacts

The cupper parts of 
 the contacts are tarnishing when immersed in oil

sections.text: Cooling system

Check the flanged 
 joints and weld for oil leakage

items:
Check the flanged 
 joints and weld for oil leakage

All flanges seals and 
 welds must be checked for oil leaks

If any leakage found 
 we must immediately seal by retightening the screws replacing the seals or 
 by welding

Inspect condition of 
 all cooling fans

Check for cracks in 
 fan blades, test all fan motors

Check for abnormal 
 bearing noise
Cleaning the coolers:

Use water pressure to 
 clean radiators and transformer tank walls do not direct the stream of 
 water directly at the cooling fans

The unsealed wiring 
 must be covered by plastic covering to avoid s.c in wiring system

The coolers must be 
 cleaned at least when the oil temperature tends to rise while transformer 
 load and inlet temperatures of air or water remain constant

sections.text: Control cabinet

items:
Check the heating and lighting of the 
 control cubicle

The thermostat of the control cubicle 
 heating
Check the heating for correct functioning

Check cubicle lighting for correct 
 functioning (door contact)

Inspect transformer control cabinet and 
 blow out dust
Check condition of door seal

Check all electrical connection for 
 tightness
Check proper operation of space heaters
Test operation of fan control

sections.text: Bushings

items: Check for oil leaks bushings, bushing domes

The pipes leading to the bushings must be 
 checked for oil leaks
Clean the porcelain surfaces on all bushing

The intervals, which must be specified for 
 each application, are largely dependent upon local air pollution
The average cleaning interval is 1year
Check the bushing terminals
Check the bushing terminals for light fit
Check the oil level indicators

The oil levels in the conservator or in 
 other vessels must be checked by reference to the sight glasses or oil 
 level indicators

sections.text: Buchholtz and Auxiliary Device
Operating test

items:
Open bleed valves on buchholz relay unit a 
 small amount of oil escapes test alarm and trip circuit using the test 
 button next to the vent valve

Check all electrical connection for 
 tightness

Check the corresponding signals in the 
 control room

Check all electrical connection for 
 tightness
Inspection of control circuit
Operating test

sections.text: High & Low Winding

Take and 
 record insulation resistance readings (megger readings), high voltage winding 
 to low voltage winding, high voltage to earth, low voltage to earth
Compare readings to historical data

Perform 
 transformation ratio tests in lowest, highest and neutral tap position
Measure high voltage windings (phase to phase)

Measure low voltage windings 
 (phase to phase)

Compare readings to historical data 
 readings taken at all points of tap changer

Take and record DC 
 resistance winding readings
* Each high voltage phase to neutral
* Each high voltage phase to phase
* Each low voltage phase to phase

items:

 record insulation resistance readings (megger readings), high voltage winding 
 to low voltage winding, high voltage to earth, low voltage to earth
Compare readings to historical data

Take and 
 record capacitance dissipation factor percentage tan Δ
Compare readings to historical data

Perform

Measure high voltage windings (phase to phase)

Measure low voltage windings 
 (phase to phase)

Compare readings to historical data 
 readings taken at all points of tap changer
* Each low voltage phase to phase
Compare readings to historical data

sections_ar.text: مقدمة
توضح هذه الوثيقة إجراءات الصيانة البسيطة P1، التي يجب تنفيذها كل عشر سنوات كما هو موضح بالرمز Y10 في خانة العنوان أعلاه.
أعد المسودة الأولى م. Amr Gaber، وراجعها م. Mohamed Abbas Ahmad، واختبرها م. Mohammed El-bayaa، وقبلها المدير العام م. Mohamed Abbas Ahmad، واعتمدها م. Mahmoud El-Naquib رئيس قطاع محطة Ayoun Moussa.
وثّق هذه الوثيقة م. Mohamed Fayez Hassan، منسق MPIS في EDEPC.
احتياطات السلامة

items: يجب إصدار تصريح عمل، ويجب أن يحمل طاقم الصيانة المؤهل فئة السلامة المناسبة
يلزم وجود سياج أمان بعلامات تحذيرية يحيط بمنطقة العمل
ارتدِ خوذة السلامة وحذاء السلامة وقناع التنفس وحزام الأمان....
يلزم عزل المحول وتأريضه من جميع الجهات
يوجد خطر السقوط في حفرة تجميع الزيت عند العمل بالقرب من محول قدرة كبير
يجب استخدام سلم مثبت تثبيتًا جيدًا للصعود إلى أعلى خزان المحول

sections_ar.text: الأدوات والمعدات

ملتيميتر
منفاخ هواء

sections_ar.text: الأعمال المطلوب تنفيذها
نظام زيت المحول

افحص درجة حرارة الزيت للتأكد مما إذا كانت درجة حرارة الزيت أو الملفات تقع في مدى مرضٍ بالنسبة لقيمها الواردة في تقرير الاختبار وحالة الحمل ودرجة حرارة الجو المحيط. ولا يجوز تحميل المحول بأكثر من قدرته إلا وفقًا للمواصفة المعمول بها.

items: افحص درجة حرارة الزيت للتأكد مما إذا كانت درجة حرارة الزيت أو الملفات تقع في مدى مرضٍ بالنسبة لقيمها الواردة في تقرير الاختبار وحالة الحمل ودرجة حرارة الجو المحيط. ولا يجوز تحميل المحول بأكثر من قدرته إلا وفقًا للمواصفة المعمول بها.
افحص الوصلات ذات الفلنشات واللحامات من حيث تسرب الزيت
يجب فحص جميع الفلنشات والجوانات واللحامات من حيث تسرب الزيت
إذا وُجد أي تسرب فيجب إحكامه فورًا بإعادة ربط المسامير أو استبدال الجوانات أو باللحام
إذا تم ترميم طبقة الدهان النهائية في الوقت المناسب، فلن تكون هناك حاجة في العادة إلى تجديد طبقة الدهان بالكامل
نظّف السطح المطلي بقطعة قماش مبللة بالمذيب أو بنفاث بخار
ادهن جميع أسطح المحول
